note: Read a style object key that holds an object and names no style property as a nested selector, as Emotion and styled-components do, in css(), globalCss(), styled object styles, the css prop and the Emotion and styled-components imports: `span: {...}` and `'h1, h2': {...}` select descendants instead of styling the element itself or being dropped, a bare pseudo-class, pseudo-element or media shorthand name such as `hover` stays that selector as in the selectors prop, and `:`, `::`, `[` and `&` keys keep applying to the element.
